cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L2 calls require conservative imported-type attribution; repository helpers and query wrappers are missed.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: signals-split-across-classes
cases.tradeoff: Transaction/entity-graph annotations in one class cannot borrow lock/query evidence from another repository class.

cases.name: comments-and-strings
cases.tradeoff: Comments and string literals are not executable query or annotation facts.
